validation_queries.error_message: Expected at least one 'annotated_region' region from the user annotated-region API.
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM regions WHERE name = 'annotated_region'

validation_queries.description: The annotated_region carries the push-time 'size' annotation of 4096
validation_queries.error_message: Expected the annotated_region to record a 'size' trace-arg equal to 4096 from the push annotations.
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM region_args A INNER JOIN regions R ON R.id = A.id AND R.guid = A.guid WHERE R.name = 'annotated_region' AND A.name = 'size' AND A.value = '4096'
